svg.title: openmeet-engine: RequestManager, slots and stale-response suppression

g.text: openmeet-engine: RequestManager, slots and stale-response suppression
begin(): for Primary / Followups the previous request of
the slot is cancelled (token + AnswerStateChanged Cancelled)
and started_event is emitted under the same lock.
Background requests never cancel each other.
emit_if_current(): check + emit happen under the slot lock,
so a stale delta cannot follow a newer ANSWER_STARTED.
set_state(): AnswerStateChanged only for UI slots, while
current, or always when the state is terminal.
Background work alive; emergency_stop uses cancel_all(true).
